load-pdf-extract-acroform-fields.title: Load PDF and List AcroForm Fields
load-pdf-extract-acroform-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf, accessing its AcroForm, and enumerating each form field with its current value.

read-acroform-fields-from-pdf-stream.title: Read AcroForm Fields from PDF Stream
read-acroform-fields-from-pdf-stream.description: Shows how to open a PDF as a read‑only stream with Aspose.Pdf, access its AcroForm, and enumerate all form fields displaying their names, types, and current values without saving the file to disk.

retrieve-acroform-fields-from-pdf.title: Retrieve All AcroForm Fields from a PDF
retrieve-acroform-fields-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF document, accesses its AcroForm, and iterates through all form fields, printing each field's name, type, and partial name.

retrieve-pdf-form-field-value.title: Retrieve PDF Form Field by Name
retrieve-pdf-form-field-value.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, accessing a specific form field using the Document.Form indexer, and outputting its type and value.

list-form-fields-per-pdf-page.title: List Form Fields on Each PDF Page
list-form-fields-per-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and retrieve any form field widgets (WidgetAnnotation) present on each page.

enumerate-pdf-form-fields.title: Enumerate PDF Form Fields on a Specific Page
enumerate-pdf-form-fields.description: Shows how to list all form fields that belong to a given page of a PDF, outputting each field's name, type, and current value using Aspose.Pdf.

read-checkbox-value-to-boolean.title: Read Checkbox Field Value as Boolean
read-checkbox-value-to-boolean.description: Loads a PDF, retrieves a checkbox form field, reads its Value property and converts it to a Boolean indicating whether the box is checked.

parse-number-fields-to-decimal.title: Parse Numeric Text Box Fields from PDF Form
parse-number-fields-to-decimal.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through its form fields, extracts numeric values from text box fields, parses them to decimal, and demonstrates a simple calculation on the extracted numbers.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON Stream
export-pdf-form-data-to-json.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF document with a form and export its field data directly to a JSON file using a FileStream.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-xml.title: Export PDF Form Fields to XML
export-pdf-form-fields-to-xml.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates over its form fields, and writes each field's name, type, and value to an XML file using a FileStream and XmlWriter.

export-pdf-form-to-fdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON
export-pdf-form-to-fdf.description: Loads a PDF document, checks for form fields, and exports the form data to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf's core Form API.

export-acroform-to-xfdf.title: Export AcroForm Fields to XFDF
export-acroform-to-xfdf.description: Loads a PDF, verifies the presence of AcroForm fields, and exports those fields to an XFDF file using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-to-html-png-xfdf.title: Export PDF to Multiple Formats with Aspose.Pdf
export-pdf-to-html-png-xfdf.description: Loads a PDF document and exports it to HTML, SVG, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, and XML, using Aspose.Pdf save options and ensuring each FileStream is closed after the operation.

modify-checkbox-appearance-extract-value.title: Modify Checkbox Appearance and Extract Its Value
modify-checkbox-appearance-extract-value.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, locating a checkbox form field, changing its rectangle (position/size), reading its checked state, and saving the modified document.

extract-pdf-form-field-values.title: Extract PDF Form Fields to Dictionary
extract-pdf-form-field-values.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating over its form fields, and returning a case‑insensitive dictionary of field names and their string values.

combine-pdf-form-data-into-json-array.title: Combine PDF Form Data into JSON Batch
combine-pdf-form-data-into-json-array.description: Extracts form fields from multiple PDFs, aggregates the data into a list of objects, and writes the combined result as a pretty‑printed JSON array.

log-pdf-form-extraction-timestamps.title: Extract PDF Form Fields with Timestamp Logging
log-pdf-form-extraction-timestamps.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate over its form fields, and log start and end timestamps for the extraction run.

serialize-pdf-form-data-to-json-bytes.title: Extract PDF Form Data to JSON Byte Array
serialize-pdf-form-data-to-json-bytes.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, extracts all interactive form field names and values, serializes the data to JSON, and returns it as a byte array via a MemoryStream for API consumption.

export-pdf-form-fields-with-prefix-to-js.title: Export PDF Form Fields with Prefix Filter
export-pdf-form-fields-with-prefix-to-js.description: Loads a PDF, filters its form fields whose names start with a specified prefix, and writes the field names and values to a text file.

count-acroform-fields-in-pdf.title: Count AcroForm Fields in PDF
count-acroform-fields-in-pdf.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, accesses the Form collection, and prints the total number of AcroForm fields present in the document.

iterate-modify-pdf-form-fields.title: Iterate Over PDF Form Fields and Modify Values
iterate-modify-pdf-form-fields.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each form field using a foreach loop, outputs field information, and demonstrates how to set values for text boxes and check boxes before saving the document.

retrieve-pdf-form-field-types.title: Retrieve Form Field Types from PDF
retrieve-pdf-form-field-types.description: The example opens a PDF, verifies that it contains form fields, and prints each field's name along with its runtime type using the GetType() method.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON via MemoryStream
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Loads a PDF document, accesses its AcroForm, and writes the form fields as JSON directly into a MemoryStream. The stream is then read back and the JSON is displayed.

export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to FDF Using FileStream
export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf.description: Loads a PDF, verifies it contains form fields, and writes those fields to an FDF file using a FileStream and StreamWriter.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, accessing its AcroForm, and exporting the form data to an XFDF file using a FileStream.

count-form-fields-on-each-pdf-page.title: Count Form Fields per PDF Page
count-form-fields-on-each-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its form fields, count the fields on each page, and log the per‑page totals.

extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.title: Extract Vector Graphics from PDF Page to SVG
extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.description: Loads a PDF, extracts a single page, and saves its vector graphics as an SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

combine-pdf-page-vector-graphics-into-sv.title: Extract Vector Graphics to Multi‑Page SVG
combine-pdf-page-vector-graphics-into-sv.description: Loads a PDF document and saves its vector graphics as a single multi‑page SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-subpaths-pdf-png.title: Extract PDF Graphics Subpaths to PNG Images
extract-subpaths-pdf-png.description: Shows how to use GraphicsAbsorber to capture graphics on each PDF page and save each subpath as an individual PNG file.

export-pdf-page-as-png.title: Export PDF Page as PNG with Specified DPI
export-pdf-page-as-png.description: Demonstrates how to rasterize a PDF page to a PNG image at a custom resolution using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-graphic-element-as-svg.title: Extract Graphic Element from PDF and Save as SVG
extract-graphic-element-as-svg.description: Demonstrates how to locate an image on a PDF page by its index, copy it into a new PDF, and export that page as an SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-first-page-text-to-utf8-file.title: Extract First Page Text from PDF to UTF-8 File
extract-first-page-text-to-utf8-file.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract the text of the first page using a TextAbsorber, and save the result to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

extract-text-from-pdf-to-txt.title: Extract Text from PDF to TXT
extract-text-from-pdf-to-txt.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, use TextAbsorber to extract plain text from all pages, and write the concatenated result to a .txt file.

extract-pdf-stamp-texts-to-json.title: Extract Stamp Texts from PDF to JSON
extract-pdf-stamp-texts-to-json.description: Shows how to read a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate StampAnnotation objects, collect their text content, and write the results as a JSON array.

extract-superscript-subscript-from-pdf.title: Detect Superscript and Subscript in PDF Text
extract-superscript-subscript-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, extracts text fragments with Aspose.Pdf, and uses font size and baseline heuristics to identify superscript and subscript characters, marking them with Unicode superscript/subscript symbols.

extract-paragraphs-with-line-breaks.title: Extract Paragraph Text from PDF Preserving Line Breaks
extract-paragraphs-with-line-breaks.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracting its text while keeping paragraph and line breaks using TextAbsorber and TextExtractionOptions, and writing the result to a .txt file.

extract-images-from-pdf.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as PNG
extract-images-from-pdf.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf, extract each embedded XImage, and write it out as a PNG file.

extract-fonts-from-pdf-ttf.title: Extract Embedded Fonts from PDF as TTF/OTF Files
extract-fonts-from-pdf-ttf.description: Demonstrates how to read a PDF, locate embedded font resources, and save them as .ttf or .otf files using Aspose.Pdf, with support for both modern and legacy library versions.

extract-pdf-tables-to-csv.title: Extract PDF Tables to CSV Files
extract-pdf-tables-to-csv.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to locate tables in a PDF document and export each discovered table as an individual CSV file.

export-acroform-fields-to-json.title: Extract AcroForm Fields to JSON
export-acroform-fields-to-json.description: Shows how to read AcroForm field names and values from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and serialize the collected data into a JSON file.

batch-extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.title: Batch Convert PDF Pages to SVG
batch-extract-vector-graphics-to-svg.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF files in a folder, create a single‑page document for each page, and save each page as an SVG vector graphic using Aspose.Pdf.

parallel-pdf-text-extraction.title: Parallel PDF Text Extraction with TPL
parallel-pdf-text-extraction.description: Demonstrates how to extract text from multiple PDF files concurrently using the Task Parallel Library and Aspose.Pdf's TextAbsorber.

export-pdf-to-svg-with-custom-options.title: Export PDF to SVG with DPI and CSS Styling
export-pdf-to-svg-with-custom-options.description: Shows how to load a PDF, configure SVG export options such as raster image resolution (DPI) and CSS scaling, and save the document as an SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

filter-export-large-graphics-pdf.title: Extract Large Images from PDF by Area
filter-export-large-graphics-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through each page's image resources, filtering images based on a minimum width × height area, and saving the qualifying images to disk.

extract-graphics-from-specific-pdf-pages.title: Extract Vector Graphics from Specific PDF Pages
extract-graphics-from-specific-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's GraphicsAbsorber to visit selected pages and extract vector graphics from a PDF document.

combine-pdf-vectors-to-svg.title: Combine Multiple PDFs into a Multi‑Page SVG
combine-pdf-vectors-to-svg.description: Demonstrates merging several PDF documents and exporting the combined result as a single multi‑page SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-subpaths-as-separate-svg.title: Export Subpaths of a PDF Graph as Separate PNG Images
extract-subpaths-as-separate-svg.description: Loads a PDF, extracts each Path (subpath) from Graph shapes, creates a temporary PDF page containing only that path, and renders it to a PNG file with a transparent background.

export-pdf-pages-to-svg-preserving-coord.title: Convert PDF to SVG Preserving Original Coordinate System
export-pdf-pages-to-svg-preserving-coord.description: Demonstrates how to convert a PDF file to SVG using Aspose.Pdf while keeping the original coordinate system by enabling the ScaleToPixels option.

pdf-summary-report-text-image-count.title: Extract PDF Text and Count Images & Graphics
pdf-summary-report-text-image-count.description: The example opens one or more PDF files, extracts all textual content, counts the total number of characters, and tallies embedded raster images and vector graphics (XObjects) using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-font-table-form-field-statis.title: Extract PDF Font, Table, and Form Field Counts
extract-pdf-font-table-form-field-statis.description: Demonstrates how to open PDF files with Aspose.Pdf and count the number of fonts, tables, and form fields present in each document.

validate-pdf-fonts-against-system.title: Validate PDF Font Dependencies Against System Fonts
validate-pdf-fonts-against-system.description: Loads a PDF, extracts all font names referenced in the document, enumerates the fonts installed on the operating system, and reports any missing fonts required by the PDF.

extract-pdf-metadata-and-save-svg.title: Extract PDF Metadata and Save Pages as SVG
extract-pdf-metadata-and-save-svg.description: Shows how to read basic PDF metadata (author and title) and export each page to a vector SVG file using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-paragraphs-to-markdown.title: Extract PDF Text to Markdown Preserving Indentation
extract-pdf-paragraphs-to-markdown.description: Loads a PDF, extracts raw text while keeping spaces and line breaks, splits it into paragraphs, and writes each paragraph to a Markdown file inside fenced code blocks to retain the original indentation.

export-pdf-tables-to-csv-with-borders.title: Export PDF Tables to CSV with Visual Delimiter Markers
export-pdf-tables-to-csv-with-borders.description: Loads a PDF, extracts its text while preserving layout, splits the text into rows and columns based on spacing, adds visual delimiter markers around each cell, and writes the result to a CSV file.

extract-checkbox-states-from-pdf.title: Extract Checkbox States from PDF AcroForm
extract-checkbox-states-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, checks for an AcroForm, iterates over its fields, extracts the checked state of each checkbox, and outputs the results as a JSON boolean array.

extract-svg-apply-brand-colors.title: Apply Brand Palette Colors to PDF Exported SVG
extract-svg-apply-brand-colors.description: Shows how to convert a PDF to SVG using Aspose.Pdf, then replace specific colors in the SVG content to match a brand palette before saving the final file.

extract-vector-graphics-from-encrypted-p.title: Extract Vector Graphics from Encrypted PDF to SVG
extract-vector-graphics-from-encrypted-p.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF with a password using Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and save each page as an SVG file to capture vector graphics.
